verdict.rationale: Extend documents an official MCP integration (docs.extend.ai/mcp) and runtime probes confirm a live, OAuth-protected hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.extend.ai/mcp responding correctly to protocol handshakes, alongside a separate docs MCP server — clear evidence of a genuine, working official MCP server for agent connectivity. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of connecting an agent to the MCP server in practice (only vendor docs and protocol-level probes, no third-party usage account).
